installCommand: export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && npm install --global pnpm@10.13.1 && (ln -sf "$(npm prefix -g)/bin/pnpm" /pnpm6/node_modules/.bin/pnpm 2>/dev/null || true) && cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @settler/api build
